name: Imunga Trade Language
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

sources.citation: Jones, Alan A. 1998. Towards a lexicogrammar of Mekeo (an Austronesian language of West Central Papua). Pacific Linguistics C-138. Canberra: Australian National University. xx+601 pp. doi:10.15144/PL-C138.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: open copy online
sources.note: Nothing on stress in the Imunga Trade Language; the pidgin is mentioned only in passing (printed p. 8, PDF p. 28: 'two inland trade languages which contain large quantities of Kunimaipa vocabulary combined with a radically simplified Mekeo grammar (one in Imunga and one in Ioi)'). For Mekeo proper (the grammatical lexifier) sec. 1.3.3.3, printed p. 67 (PDF p. 87): 'Mekeo is a stress-timed language oriented to a system of predetermined word stresses (with the main stress on the penultimate syllable and a secondary stress on every second syllable leftward from that).'

sources.citation: Jones, Alan Anthony. 1993. Towards a lexicogrammar of Mekeo. PhD thesis, Australian National University. xxix+781 pp. hdl:1885/133193.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Same passing mention of the Imunga and Ioi trade languages (PDF p. 39); nothing on their phonology or stress.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.3 languoid record imun1234 (Imunga Trade Language; classification Pidgin > Mekeo-based pidgin) and reference record 119660.
